definitions: Physical, sexual, or emotional mistreatment or neglect of a child.

Any act or failure to act on the part of a parent or caretaker which results in death, serious physical or emotional harm, sexual abuse or exploitation, or an act or failure to act which presents an imminent risk of serious harm to a child.
examples: The social worker investigated the allegations of child abuse.
Child abuse is a serious crime.
Preventing child abuse requires community effort.
